title: Enriched presheaf rectification with coherent representable comparison
statement:
Use the infinity-category, quasicategory, coherent-functor, and universe conventions of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones] and the $\mathcal U$-small space category of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces].  The coherent nerve and its simplicial-category comparisons are those of [lem-coef-coherent-nerve-comparison].  Use enriched diagram rectification from [lem-coef-enriched-diagram-rectification], the projective simplicial presheaf model structure from [lem-coef-simplicial-presheaf-projective-model], the general simplicial projective-model calculus from [lem-coef-simplicial-projective-model-calculus], and the bifibrant localization nerve comparison from [lem-coef-simplicial-model-nerve-localization].

Fix universes $\mathcal U\in\mathcal U'$.  Let $D$ be a $\mathcal U$-small quasicategory and $\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}$ the infinity category of $\mathcal U$-small spaces.  There are a $\mathcal U$-small locally Kan simplicial category $A$, an equivalence $q:N_{\mathrm{hc}}A\simeq D$, and the projective simplicial model category
\[
\mathsf M=\operatorname{Fun}_{\Delta}(A^{\mathrm{op}},\mathrm{sSet})
\]
with objectwise weak equivalences and fibrations, such that, for its full simplicial subcategory $B=\mathsf M^{cf}$, there is an equivalence
\[
\Theta:N_{\mathrm{hc}}B\simeq \operatorname{Fun}(D^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S_{\mathcal U}).
\]
The equivalence $\Theta$ is induced by enriched evaluation and the coherent nerve, is natural in the diagram variable, and preserves enriched mapping complexes, evaluation at every object, composition, and identity simplices.  For $a\in A$, the enriched representable $Y_a=A(-,a)$ is cofibrant-fibrant and $\Theta(Y_a)$ is equivalent to the representable presheaf $j(q(a))$, by an equivalence carrying the identity vertex $1_a\in Y_a(a)$ to $\operatorname{id}_{q(a)}$.  The construction and all comparisons are formed in $\mathcal U'$, while each diagram value and mapping space is $\mathcal U$-small.

The representable comparison is coherent in $a$: the composite of the enriched representable diagram $Y:A\to B$ with $\Theta$ is naturally equivalent to $j\circ q$. On $A^{\mathrm{op}}\times B$, the comparison identifies the nerves of the enriched mapping functor $(a,P)\mapsto\underline{\operatorname{Map}}_{\mathsf M}(Y_a,P)$ and enriched evaluation $(a,P)\mapsto P(a)$ with the coherent mapping bifunctor $H_{\mathcal P}$ of [lem-coef-space-transport-classification] for $\mathcal P=\operatorname{Fun}(D^{\mathrm{op}},\mathcal S_{\mathcal U})$, restricted along $j\circ q$ in the first variable, and with the evaluation bifunctor $(x,F)\mapsto F(x)$ of that functor category, restricted along $q$. These are coherent comparisons, respecting restriction at $a$ and evaluation at the identity, as well as composition and all higher simplices. Here $j$ is the coherent Yoneda construction of [def-coef-infinity-presheaf-yoneda].
